verdict.rationale: The only evidence of API versioning is a passing mention that Mollie accepts multicurrency payments 'through its v2 APIs'. This implies a versioned API surface, but nothing documents a versioning scheme, version lifecycle, or any deprecation or sunset policy. missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy, version lifecycle and support timelines, changelog or migration guidance, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Mollie enables you to accept payments in currencies beyond EUR through its v2 APIs
